3. Verify no inference beyond text:
   - All values taken verbatim from invoice text; where role ambiguous (two UID numbers), selected the bottom "Ust - Idnr." as Sender.VatId because it labels Ust-Idnr. and appears in sender block.
   - No other fields inferred.

4. Prepare to output:
   - Will populate JSON fields accordingly, with Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount reflecting the VAT groups present (multiple entries) and Sender.VatId as ATU64040013.
   - If any schema requires numeric types, will convert comma decimals to dot decimals preserving two decimals (as in source).
